name: get_project_info
description: Get the open After Effects project: version, file path, active item and a summary of every composition.

name: list_items
description: List project items (compositions, footage, folders) with ids, names and sizes.

type.description: Filter by item type. Default: all.

name: get_comp_details
description: Get a composition's settings and every layer (index, name, type, timing, parent, transform, effects).

comp.description: Composition name or item id. Omit for the active composition.

name: create_composition
description: Create a new composition and (by default) open it in the viewer.

open.description: Open in the viewer. Default true.

name: add_layer
description: Add a layer to a composition: text, solid, adjustment, null, shape (rectangle/ellipse), camera or light. Layers are added at the top of the stack, centered.

comp.description: Composition name or id. Omit for the active comp.

font.description: Text layers: PostScript font name, e.g. "Arial-BoldMT".

color.description: Fill color for text/solid/shape: "#rrggbb" or [r,g,b]. For shape, null means no fill.

strokeColor.description: Shape layers: add a stroke with this color.

position.description: [x, y] or [x, y, z] in comp pixels.

name: set_layer_properties
description: Change a layer's attributes and property values. 'properties' maps property paths to values, e.g. {"Position": [960, 540], "Opacity": 50, "Scale": 80, "Rotation": 45, "Source Text": "Hello", "Effects/Gaussian Blur/Blurriness": 10}. If a property already has keyframes, the value is set at the current time.

layer.description: Layer name or 1-based index. Omit to use the single selected layer.

properties.description: Property path -> value. Colors accept "#rrggbb". Source Text accepts a string or {text, fontSize, font, fillColor, strokeColor, strokeWidth, tracking, leading, justification}.

parent.description: Parent layer name/index, or null to unparent.

blendingMode.description: e.g. NORMAL, ADD, SCREEN, MULTIPLY, OVERLAY.

name: set_keyframes
description: Add keyframes to a layer property. Example: property "Position", keyframes [{"time":0,"value":[0,540]},{"time":2,"value":[1920,540]}], interpolation "easy_ease".

name: set_expression
description: Set (or clear with an empty string) an expression on a layer property, e.g. "wiggle(2, 30)" on Position.

name: list_effects
description: Search the effects installed in After Effects (display name, match name, category).

name: apply_effect
description: Apply an effect to a layer and optionally set its parameters. Returns the effect's parameter names and values.

effect.description: Display name ("Gaussian Blur") or match name ("ADBE Gaussian Blur 2").

name: get_layer_properties
description: Inspect a layer's property tree (names, match names, values, keyframe counts, expressions). Use it to discover property paths.

path.description: Start at this group, e.g. "Transform" or "Effects". Default: the whole layer.

name: layer_action
description: Delete, duplicate, reorder or precompose a layer.

new_name.description: duplicate / precompose: name for the new layer or comp.

name: import_file
description: Import a file (image, video, audio, .ai/.psd, image sequence) into the project, optionally adding it to a composition.

add_to_comp.description: Also add it as a layer to this composition.

name: render_comp
description: Add a composition to the Render Queue with an output path, and optionally render immediately (renders the whole queue; After Effects is busy until it finishes).

output_path.description: Absolute output file path, e.g. C:\\Renders\\intro.mp4.

output_module_template.description: e.g. "H.264 - Match Render Settings - 15 Mbps". The result lists available templates.

name: preview_frame
description: Render one frame of a composition and return it as an image, to check what the comp looks like.

max_size.description: Longest side of the returned image in pixels. Default 1024.

name: save_project
description: Save the project, or save it to a new .aep path.

path.description: Absolute .aep path. Required if the project was never saved.

name: run_extendscript
description: Run arbitrary ExtendScript (ES3 JavaScript) in After Effects for anything the other tools don't cover. The value of the last expression is returned as JSON. Helpers available: findComp(nameOrId), findLayer(comp, nameOrIndex), resolveProp(layer, 'Path/To/Prop'), setProp(prop, value), toColor(c), describeLayer(l), describeComp(c). The script runs in one undo group.
